21 CFR 70.3(v) [3] defines "externally applied drugs and externally applied cosmetics" as substances applied only to external parts of the body and not to the lips or any body surface covered by mucous membrane, thereby excluding lipsticks and toothpastes because both are applied to mucous membrane surfaces.

21 CFR 82.1255(a) [1] requires that D&C Orange No. 5 conform in identity and specifications to §74.1255(a)(1) and (b).

21 CFR 82.1255(b) [2] limits the use of D&C Orange No. 5 to no more than 5.0 percent by weight in lipsticks and other cosmetics applied to the lips, and to amounts consistent with current good manufacturing practice in mouthwashes, dentifrices, and externally applied cosmetics.

21 CFR 82.1050 [4] requires that a batch of D&C Orange No. 5 used in drugs or cosmetics must conform to the requirements of §82.5 and to the specifications set forth in this subpart for such color.
